texts.text: Short US pulses are interspersed; they are not conditioning pairings.
Same long-US times; training CS onsets randomized per fish
Distal cumulative angle; -15 to 0 s median centred
Each strip is the matching frozen V12 heatmap row · all 80 bins shown
Raw display capped at 1 rad/ms: 12 frame values exceed the range.
Frozen colours saturate at ±1 (12 bins); missing bins are black. Signed data are not clipped.
